request_messages.content: You are evaluating a synthetic interpersonal situation. Use only the facts explicitly provided in this conversation. Do not add motives, events, demographic assumptions, or relationship history that are not stated. Treat uncertainty as legitimate. We are assessing a synthetic relationship case. Interpretation A is that Alex has special or potentially romantic interest in Jordan. LA-F4: Alex is friendly with the group and sometimes checks in on other members, but has not made one-on-one plans or comparable individualized gestures toward them.

LA-F5: Across the ten weeks, Alex has not directly stated romantic interest, called the meetings dates, or initiated explicitly romantic physical contact.
